checks.name: Strict attachment request rejects symbols, arbitrary file bytes and accessors without invoking them
Image and Office readers share exactly eight actual child slots
Cancelled result retains its slot until actual exit and kills a late spawn; duplicate exit cannot double release
Malformed decoder result fails closed without private diagnostic/body leakage
Encoded image dimension bomb is rejected before creating any decoder process
Thumbnail output rejects non-local image URLs
Native picker reserves host owner synchronously before asynchronous selection
Cancellation returns promptly but retains native chooser owner until late selection actually settles
Archive after native picker starts rejects late paths before any file import
Closing coordinator refuses new local attachment requests

scope: Actual strict contracts/host/coordinator with transport and store doubles; formal native SQLite/UI is a separate report.
